fields.description: Grove on the Park offers one- to three-bedroom apartments in Town Square. Its residential spaces extend into a landscaped courtyard with a pool, deck and children’s play areas, while the wider neighbourhood provides parkland, shops and walking routes.

overview: Grove combines a park-neighbourhood setting with resident leisure spaces. Apartment variants differ in balcony size, making the exact drawing more useful than a single headline size range.
research.locationNote: Town Square, Dubai. The developer places Grove near the community park; views and walking routes should be checked for the selected apartment.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s actual project record gives an AED 821,305 starting reference. This historical guide does not establish a current unit price or availability.
research.paymentNote: The original calendar, shown below, is historical. A new reservation or resale requires its own confirmed payment terms.
